items.rationale: Share = 350 / 2,000 = 0.175. Multiply by 100 to read it as a percentage: 17.5%.
Percent means out of 100, so 0.4 is 0.4 x 100 = 40 out of 100, which is 40%. 4% would be 0.04 and 0.4% would be 0.004.
A normal reference moves when you copy a formula down, so B7 becomes B8, which is empty, and dividing by zero gives #DIV/0!. Writing $B$7 locks the reference to the total.
Shares of a complete total add up to 1, so the fourth share is 1 - 0.4 - 0.2 - 0.15 = 0.25.
